items.title: Reggie Gilliam (knee) back at practice Friday
items.desc: Reggie Gilliam returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Gilliam will still need to be monitored on the injury report when it is released this afternoon.

items.title: Christian Barmore (shoulder) misses practice Friday
items.desc: Christian Barmore did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Barmore missed practice all week. He'll likely be ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills when the official injury report is released.
